own_solution.law: Faraday's law with Ohm's law: Q = integral I dt = N*dPhi/R = N*B*pi*r^2/R (self-inductance negligible)
assumptions: coil fully inside uniform solenoid field

TA07A.regime: solenoid radius >= coil radius (3 cm), so the whole coil area carries the field; 7 cm is inside this regime

notes: N*B*A = 200*0.08*pi*(0.03)^2 = 0.0452389 Wb; Q = 0.0452389/12 = 3.770e-3 C; with 21.5 ohm Q = 2.104e-3 C. Fall time: EMF = N*dPhi/dt and I = EMF/R both scale with 1/t, so Q = I*t is independent of t (C). The problem already says the coil lies entirely inside the solenoid, so the solenoid radius 7 cm is consistent (it exceeds 3 cm). 'Wound on a tube of radius 7 cm' vs 'inner radius of 7 cm' differ slightly in what radius is meant, but both exceed the coil radius. T676D and TD305 are numeral-free controls.
